url.title: Product URL
url.description: JD.com, Taobao or Tmall product URL.

mode.title: Capture mode
mode.description: auto = structured extraction + browser capture; structured-only = public product actor only; browser-only = browser capture only.

includePrice.title: Fetch current JD price separately
includePrice.description: JD detail responses can mask price; this optionally calls the price operation too. Ignored for Taobao/Tmall.

captureLargeImages.title: Capture large detail images
captureLargeImages.description: Captures the largest product/detail images after scrolling. Useful for dimension and installation drawings embedded as images.

downloadLargeImageOriginals.title: Save original image bytes
downloadLargeImageOriginals.description: For selected large images, also request and save the original image bytes, preserving more detail than an element screenshot when the CDN permits it.

captureNetworkJson.title: Capture selected JSON responses
captureNetworkJson.description: Records bounded JSON/XHR/fetch responses observed by the real browser. This can expose product specs that are injected dynamically into the page.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional standard Apify proxy configuration. Leave disabled unless the page does not load normally. Do not use this Actor to bypass login or CAPTCHA requirements.
